overall_note: Every computed number I could recheck matches exactly: structure, pivots, profiles, virgin status, L2. But the W map leans on the 5039.7 all-time high as its protected level and dates the W turn to 2025-W14, well after the chart turned. The zone layer doesn't discriminate: 32 of 41 zones are strong, and the 7 nearest zones tile 2970-4040 with gaps of 2.5-40 points, so 'strong' and the zone edges add little to the read.
